notes.title: Steam Achievements Are GO!
notes.content:
[h1]True Colours developer Borealis here![/h1]

It's official - [b]True Colours will officially feature Steam achievements upon release![/b]  I've worked hard to bring you a colourful array of rewards and unexpected goals to hit, so I hope you're ready to explore!

While my first game - Venus: Improbable Dream - only had 17 achievements, True Colours will have a whopping 47!  Some of them are big plot points, some of them will reward you with a new CG to enjoy in the gallery, and others are just plain funny - here's a small selection!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43506285/51b65dcd16e6e5f8bd9d6f18ed44def947a8eb52.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43506285/c5d17bc16e5a503881060c078a3792dc29c45b5b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43506285/1ffe62f9e3c6353388ec2b3c09ecfdae6765d85d.png[/img]

I think you're gonna love unlocking some of these babies.  Besides, how many games reward you for snuggling puppies AND perving on butts?!

[h1]I'll be back with more updates soon!
Borealis[/h1]

notes.title: True Colours Extended Demo Has Arrived!
notes.content:
[b]Amazing news, gamers![/b]

Borealis here with a wonderful announcement - [b]the True Colours Extended Demo is now live and can be downloaded for free on the game's store page![/b]  Wanna know what awesome new content awaits you?  Here's a little list of all the goodies you can expect:

[list]
[*] Extra gameplay, spanning roughly 2 hours instead of 45 mins
[*] More player choices and interactivity
[*] The chance to experience the beginnings of Brianna, Malik and Ash's routes, including a first date with each of them
[*] New artwork and music
[*] Voice acting
[*] An option to skip straight to the new content for those who've already played the original demo
[/list]

Sounds pretty sweet, huh?  If you wanna get your hands on this extended adventure, [b]head to the store page and download it for free now![/b]  I can't wait to hear what you think~

[b]Enjoy!
Borealis[/b]

notes.title: Voice Acting Is Coming To True Colours!
notes.content:
[b]Get your ears ready, gamers!  Borealis here with some BIG news![/b]

You read correctly - it's my absolute pleasure to announce that True Colours will officially feature voice acting!  This is something that Venus: Improbable Dream didn't have.  So many new features are coming to True Colours that I couldn't make happen before, and I'm so happy to be able to implement it all and share it with you!  Lemme fill you in on some sweet details about the voice acting:


[list]
[*] True Colours will be partially voice acted.  This means that instead of every single line being spoken as you read it, each character will have a set of words, short phrases and noises to reflect different emotions and responses, and one will play each time they speak.  This is a less time-consuming but still really effective way to help those characters to feel more real,  and for you to connect with them more deeply when you hear them speak!

[*] Six characters will be receiving voice actors.  Brianna, Malik, Ash, Sean, Lydia and the Boss will have their very own voices!

[*] The protagonist will not have voice acting.  I chose to leave them out for maximum self-insertability - I want you to be able to put yourself in their shoes as much as possible, and for this reason, I've already given them a gender neutral appearance.  To build on this, I believe leaving them voiceless will further enhance this transparency so that they can feel even more like 'you', without forcing you to have a specific voice.  The protagonist will have a couple of subtle noises assigned to them - breathing or gasping, for example - but no actual voice.
[/list]


So there you have it!  How's that for a sweet bonus feature?  Keep your eyes firmly on the official Borealis Games Twitter next week, because some voice acting teasers will be coming your way!

[b]See ya soon!
Borealis[/b]
